name: terra-ecosystem
description: Metaworkspace para TERRA GO, TERRA LINK y TERRA X CHANGE.

scripts.test: npm run test:terra-go && npm run test:terra-link
scripts.test:terra-go: npm --workspace terra-go-backend test && npm --workspace terra-go-frontend test && npm --workspace terra-go-contracts test
scripts.test:terra-link: npm --workspace terra-link-backend test && npm --workspace terra-link-dashboard test && npm --workspace terra-link run test:hardhat
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:terra-go && npm run test:coverage:terra-link
